note: Round-7 additions: RECENT ENGLISH-LANGUAGE pharmaceutical patents in the CARDIOVASCULAR, METABOLIC/DIABETES and RENAL therapeutic areas, priority dates 2012-2024, one per drug. Same schema as pdf_corpus_round6_manifest.json plus therapeutic_area, original_pages, pages_kept and a sha256 of the committed file. EVERY FILE IS A PAGE EXTRACT: the 25 originals total 1,210 pages and 66.5 MB; the committed extracts total 47 pages and 2,429,872 bytes (2.32 MiB), an average of 94 KB each, and the largest single file is 237 KB. Pages were chosen so that EVERY DEPICTION ON A KEPT PAGE IS CATALOGUED in pdf_manifest_round7.json - which means, unlike most of round 6, these groups are scoreable for PRECISION as well as recall. n_expected counts the distinct compounds catalogued (resolved + generic + unresolved); n_resolved counts those carrying a PubChem CID; est_structures is the exact depiction count on the kept pages, box by box, with no estimates anywhere in this round.
retrieval_note: Confirmed working this session, and both round-6 routes still hold. (a) EPO publication server, unauthenticated, for any granted EP: https://data.epo.org/publication-server/rest/v1.2/patents/EP<number>NWB1/document.pdf - B1 only, an A1 request returns HTTP 500. Used for EP3525784B1. (b) A read-through proxy asked for HTML reaches Google Patents where plain curl gets 503: `curl -H 'X-Return-Format: html' https://r.jina.ai/https://patents.google.com/patent/<ID>/en`. NEW THIS ROUND: the same proxy reaches https://patents.google.com/xhr/query, and its JSON carries a `pdf` field holding the hashed patentimages path directly - e.g. "pdf":"78/93/01/3e38ee97220088/US12247024.pdf" - so a search result can be turned into a download without fetching the patent page at all. That is how 24 of the 25 documents here were retrieved. TWO OPERATIONAL CAVEATS. The proxy TRUNCATES long JSON responses, so parse the search output with a regex over '"patent":{' blocks rather than json.loads, which fails on a cut string. And Google rate-limits: more than about two concurrent queries returns an HTML 'Sorry...' interstitial, so queries were run serially with a 12 s gap and a 30 s backoff. VERIFICATION: every patent number below was confirmed by fetching the document and reading its own title page - one candidate was initially mis-parsed as the wrong drug from a truncated OCR line and was corrected that way.

rejected.why_rejected: Not vericiguat. It is Merck's own sGC genus, 170 pages and 12.6 MB, and its drawings are R-group Markush formulae. Bayer/Adverio's vericiguat is a different family; WO2023034364A1 (Teva) was taken instead because it prints vericiguat's full systematic name beside the structure.

rejected.why_rejected: Would have duplicated the roxadustat slot with a document whose chemistry is one structure plus XRPD. US11465970B2 was kept instead precisely because it is Markush-heavy - the round needed one generic/specific discrimination stratum and this is the better one.
